issues.display_title: Issue #370: [Place List] Create DB View views_place_list
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT

Implementation Complete - Ready for Unit Testing

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.views_place_list
AS SELECT p.location_name, u.encrypt AS encrypt, (SELECT p2.location_post FROM panorra_dev.public.posts AS p2 WHERE (((p2.location_name = p.location_name) AND (p2.is_publish = true)) AND (p2.visibility = 'public')) AND (p2.banned = false) ORDER BY p2.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS location_post, (SELECT p2.thumbnail FROM panorra_dev.public.posts AS p2 WHERE (((p2.location_name = p.location_name) AND (p2.is_publish = true)) AND (p2.visibility = 'public')) AND (p2.banned = false) ORDER BY p2.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS thumbnail, count(p.id) AS total_posts, COALESCE(sum(v.view_count), 0) AS total_views, json_agg(DISTINCT jsonb_build_object('avatar', u.avatar, 'username', u.username)) FILTER (WHERE u.id IS NOT NULL) AS contributors FROM panorra_dev.public.posts AS p JOIN panorra_dev.public.users AS u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, count(*) AS view_count FROM panorra_dev.public.views GROUP BY post_id) AS v ON v.post_id = p.id WHERE ((((((p.is_publish = true) AND (p.visibility = 'public')) AND (p.banned = false)) AND (p.location_name IS NOT NULL)) AND (p.location_name != '')) AND (u.banned = false)) AND (u.id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM panorra_dev.public.users_request_delete)) GROUP BY p.location_name, u.encrypt;

Overview

Create the views_place_list database view that aggregates posts by location_name.
This is Step 1 of the Place List feature implementation.

Reference: PLACE_LIST_BRAINSTORM.md -> STEP 1

Why a View?

All existing complex list endpoints query a view (for example views_hashtag, views_timeline_post_slim, and views_nearest_posts). Using a view keeps the handler lean and the SQL independently testable.

SQL to Execute

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.views_place_list AS
SELECT
    p.location_name,
    (
        SELECT p2.location_post
        FROM public.posts p2
        WHERE p2.location_name = p.location_name
          AND p2.is_publish = true
          AND p2.visibility = 'public'
          AND p2.banned = false
        ORDER BY p2.created_at DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS location_post,
    (
        SELECT p2.thumbnail
        FROM public.posts p2
        WHERE p2.location_name = p.location_name
          AND p2.is_publish = true
          AND p2.visibility = 'public'
          AND p2.banned = false
        ORDER BY p2.created_at DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS thumbnail,
    COUNT(p.id) AS total_posts,
    COALESCE(SUM(v.view_count), 0) AS total_views,
    json_agg(
        DISTINCT jsonb_build_object(
            'avatar', u.avatar,
            'username', u.username,
            'encrypt', u.encrypt
        )
    ) FILTER (WHERE u.id IS NOT NULL) AS contributors,
    u.encrypt AS encrypt
FROM public.posts p
JOIN public.users u ON u.id = p.user_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS view_count
    FROM public.views
    GROUP BY post_id
) v ON v.post_id = p.id
WHERE p.is_publish = true
  AND p.visibility = 'public'
  AND p.banned = false
  AND p.location_name IS NOT NULL
  AND p.location_name != ''
  AND u.banned = false
  AND u.id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM public.users_request_delete)
GROUP BY p.location_name;

Validation Query

SELECT location_name, total_posts, total_views, thumbnail
FROM views_place_list
ORDER BY total_posts DESC
LIMIT 5;

Expected: rows with location_name, non-zero total_posts, total_views, and a thumbnail URL.

Acceptance Criteria

  • View views_place_list exists in the database
  • View returns correct total_posts count per location_name
  • View returns correct total_views count per location_name
  • thumbnail reflects the most recent post's thumbnail for each place
  • contributors is a JSON array of distinct user objects { avatar, username, encrypt }
  • Deactivated, banned, and soft-deleted users are excluded from results
  • Only is_publish=true, visibility=public, banned=false posts are included

issues.display_title: Issue #372: [Place List] Create Handler src/Api/handlers/Places/
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Create the Places handler package with two files: the variable handler and the main GetPlaceList handler function.
This is Step 3 + 4 of the Place List feature implementation.

Reference: PLACE_LIST_BRAINSTORM.md ? STEP 3 & STEP 4

Depends on: [Place List] Create Model src/Models/PlacesModel.go

Files to Create

src/Api/handlers/Places/PlacesVariableHandlers.go

package Places

import (
	"os"
	"time"
)

var prefix    = os.Getenv("PREFIX")
var lastLogin string = time.Now().Format("2006-01-02T15:04:05.000000")

src/Api/handlers/Places/PlacesHandlers.go

Full handler with:

  • Role validation (user and viewer both allowed)
  • Redis deactivated-user filter
  • Redis blocked-user filter (only when role == "user")
  • COUNT query for pagination total
  • Main SELECT query from views_place_list
  • Go-side contributor avatar slicing (max 4 + overflow count)
  • Legacy ec encrypt response path
  • V1 ec + sl=true encrypt response path
package Places

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/url"
	"strings"

	"panorra-api-go/src/Config"
	"panorra-api-go/src/Models"
	"panorra-api-go/src/Utils/Functions"
	"panorra-api-go/src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions"
	"panorra-api-go/src/Utils/Redis"

	"github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
)

func GetPlaceList(c *fiber.Ctx) error {
	var notInEncrypt, deactiveUser, blockUser []string
	var res = map[string]interface{}{
		"valid":   true,
		"version": 0,
	}

	ctx     := context.Background()
	redis   := Redis.RedisClient
	role    := c.Locals("role").(string)
	encrypt := c.Locals("encrypt").(string)
	ec      := c.Get("ec")

	search := c.Query("search")
	if search != "" {
		search = url.PathEscape(search)
		search = strings.ReplaceAll(search, "%2F", "/")
		search = strings.ReplaceAll(search, "%2C", ",")
		search = strings.ReplaceAll(search, "%27", "'")
	}

	page  := c.QueryInt("page")
	limit := c.QueryInt("limit")
	if page == 0 { page = 1 }
	if limit == 0 { limit = 20 }
	offset := (page * limit) - limit

	if role != "user" && role != "viewer" {
		return Functions.ErrorResponse(c, 401, fiber.ErrUnauthorized.Message, "Unauthorized")
	}

	keyDeactivatedUser := prefix + "_deactive_users_ec"
	deactivatedUser, _ := redis.Get(ctx, keyDeactivatedUser).Result()
	if deactivatedUser != "" {
		decodedUserDeactive, _ := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(deactivatedUser)
		_ = json.Unmarshal(decodedUserDeactive, &deactiveUser)
	}
	notInEncrypt = deactiveUser

	if role == "user" {
		userData := UserFunctions.UserDatas(c, encrypt)
		if userData["status"] == "error" {
			return Functions.ErrorResponse(c, 401, fiber.ErrUnauthorized.Message, "Unauthorized")
		}
		lastLogin = userData["last_login"].(string)

		keyBlockedUser := prefix + "_blocked_users_ec_" + encrypt
		blockedUsers, _ := redis.Get(ctx, keyBlockedUser).Result()
		if blockedUsers != "" {
			decodedUserBlocked, _ := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(blockedUsers)
			_ = json.Unmarshal(decodedUserBlocked, &blockUser)
		}
		notInEncrypt = append(deactiveUser, blockUser...)
	}

	var totalPlaces int64
	countQuery := Config.DB.Table("views_place_list").Select("COUNT(DISTINCT location_name)")
	if search != "" {
		countQuery.Where("location_name ILIKE ?", "%"+search+"%")
	} else {
		countQuery.Where("location_name IS NOT NULL")
	}
	if len(notInEncrypt) > 0 {
		countQuery.Where("encrypt NOT IN (?)", notInEncrypt)
	}
	countQuery.Count(&totalPlaces)
	if countQuery.Error != nil {
		return Functions.ErrorResponse(c, 500, fiber.ErrInternalServerError.Message, "Internal Server Error")
	}

	var places []Models.PlaceListItem = []Models.PlaceListItem{}
	if totalPlaces > 0 {
		query := Config.DB.Table("views_place_list").
			Select("location_name, location_post, thumbnail, total_posts, total_views, contributors, encrypt")
		if search != "" {
			query.Where("location_name ILIKE ?", "%"+search+"%")
		} else {
			query.Where("location_name IS NOT NULL")
		}
		if len(notInEncrypt) > 0 {
			query.Where("encrypt NOT IN (?)", notInEncrypt)
		}
		query.Order("total_posts DESC, total_views DESC").
			Limit(limit).Offset(offset).Scan(&places)
		if query.Error != nil {
			return Functions.ErrorResponse(c, 500, fiber.ErrInternalServerError.Message, "Internal Server Error")
		}
	}

	var shaped []Models.PlaceListItemResponse = []Models.PlaceListItemResponse{}
	for _, p := range places {
		var allContributors []Models.PlaceContributor
		if p.Contributors.RawMessage != nil {
			_ = json.Unmarshal(p.Contributors.RawMessage, &allContributors)
		}
		max := 4
		overflow := 0
		if len(allContributors) > max {
			overflow = len(allContributors) - max
			allContributors = allContributors[:max]
		}
		shaped = append(shaped, Models.PlaceListItemResponse{
			LocationName:         p.LocationName,
			LocationPost:         p.LocationPost,
			Thumbnail:            p.Thumbnail,
			TotalPosts:           p.TotalPosts,
			TotalViews:           p.TotalViews,
			Contributors:         allContributors,
			ContributorsOverflow: overflow,
		})
	}

	res["messages"]    = "List Places"
	res["data_places"] = shaped
	res["total"]       = totalPlaces

	responses := map[string]interface{}{"statusCode": 200, "data": res}

	if ec == "true" {
		if c.Query("sl") == "true" {
			MySecret, _ := Functions.KeyEncryptV1(lastLogin, encrypt)
			rowDatasSlice := []interface{}{MySecret, lastLogin, 0, res, encrypt}
			encText, err := Functions.EncryptResultV1(rowDatasSlice, "success", true, 200, c)
			if err != nil {
				return Functions.ErrorResponse(c, 500, fiber.ErrInternalServerError.Message, "Internal Server Error")
			}
			return c.Status(fiber.StatusOK).JSON(encText)
		} else {
			MySecret, _ := Functions.KeyEncrypt(lastLogin, encrypt)
			rowDatasSlice := []interface{}{MySecret, lastLogin, 0, responses}
			encText, _ := Functions.EncryptResult(rowDatasSlice, "success", true, 200)
			encResponse := map[string]interface{}{
				"messages": "List Places",
				"cry":      encText,
				"ls":       Functions.EpochTime(lastLogin),
			}
			if role == "viewer" { encResponse["e4"] = encrypt }
			return c.Status(fiber.StatusOK).JSON(encResponse)
		}
	}

	return c.Status(fiber.StatusOK).JSON(responses)
}

Acceptance Criteria

  • Directory src/Api/handlers/Places/ exists
  • PlacesVariableHandlers.go contains prefix and lastLogin package vars
  • GetPlaceList handles both role=user and role=viewer
  • Deactivated-user Redis filter applied for both roles
  • Blocked-user Redis filter applied only when role=user
  • search query param filters by location_name ILIKE
  • Pagination works correctly with page + limit params
  • contributors is sliced to max 4 avatars in the response
  • contributors_overflow is correct count of remaining contributors
  • ec=true returns legacy encrypted response
  • ec=true&sl=true returns V1 encrypted response
  • go build ./... passes with no errors

issues.display_title: Issue #374: [Places] Add Nearest (Longlat) Fetching to GET /places/list
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Enhance GET /places/list with a nearest mode that returns places sorted by Haversine distance from a given coordinate, alongside the existing global mode (no breaking changes).

Reference: PLACES_LIST_NEAREST_BRAINSTORM.md (repo root) ? full execution plan, exact code, validation checklist.

New Query Params

Param Type Notes
lat float64 Decimal degrees ? triggers nearest mode when paired with lng
lng float64 Decimal degrees ? triggers nearest mode when paired with lat
radius float64 Optional km limit; 0 or absent = unlimited

Existing params (page, limit, search) are unchanged and fully compatible with nearest mode.

Modes

Mode Trigger Sort
Global (current, unchanged) No lat/lng total_posts DESC, total_views DESC
Nearest (new) Both lat + lng present Haversine distance ASC from coordinate

New Response Field (nearest mode only)

{ "distance_km": 2.34 }

Field is omitted entirely in global mode (omitempty on *float64 pointer).

Implementation ? 7 Plugins (no DB migrations)

The views_place_list view already exposes location_post JSONB which contains latitude/longitude string keys. All changes are Go-only.

Plugin 1 ? src/Models/PlacesModel.go

Add DistanceKm *float64 to PlaceListItem and PlaceListItemResponse.

Plugin 2 ? src/Action/V1/Places/PlacesHandlers.go ? Imports

Add "fmt" and "strconv" to the import block.

Plugin 3 ? Handler: Parse Nearest Params

Insert after offset := (page * limit) - limit, before role validation:

latStr := c.Query("lat")
lngStr := c.Query("lng")
nearestMode := latStr != "" && lngStr != ""

var userLat, userLng, radius float64
if nearestMode {
    var errLat, errLng error
    userLat, errLat = strconv.ParseFloat(latStr, 64)
    userLng, errLng = strconv.ParseFloat(lngStr, 64)
    if errLat != nil || errLng != nil {
        return Functions.ErrorResponse(c, 400, fiber.ErrBadRequest.Message, "Invalid lat/lng parameters")
    }
    radius = c.QueryFloat("radius")
}

Plugin 4 ? Handler: COUNT Query Branch

In nearest mode, add WHERE filters for non-null/non-empty lat and lng in location_post JSONB.

Plugin 5 ? Handler: FETCH Query Branch

Add if nearestMode { ... } else { /* existing global query */ } block.

Nearest SELECT uses Haversine expression with LEAST/GREATEST clamp (prevents acos(NaN)):

(6371 * acos(LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(-1.0,
    cos(radians(userLat)) * cos(radians((location_post->>'latitude')::float)) *
    cos(radians((location_post->>'longitude')::float) - radians(userLng)) +
    sin(radians(userLat)) * sin(radians((location_post->>'latitude')::float))
)))) AS distance_km

Ordered by distance_km ASC NULLS LAST. Radius applied via .Having(haversineExpr) when radius > 0.

Plugin 6 ? Handler: Response Shaping

Pass DistanceKm: p.DistanceKm into the existing PlaceListItemResponse append.

Plugin 7 ? Build Validation

go build ./...
go vet ./src/Action/V1/Places/... ./src/Models/...

Validation Checklist

[ ] go build ./... ? zero errors
[ ] GET /places/list                        ? sorted by total_posts DESC, no distance_km field
[ ] GET /places/list?lat=48.8584&lng=2.2945 ? sorted by distance_km ASC, distance_km present
[ ] GET /places/list?lat=48.8584&lng=2.2945&radius=10 ? only places ? 10 km
[ ] GET /places/list?lat=48.8584&lng=2.2945&search=tower ? search + nearest combined
[ ] GET /places/list?lat=abc&lng=2.2945     ? 400 Bad Request
[ ] GET /places/list?lat=48.8&lng=          ? global mode (lng empty = no nearest mode)
[ ] contributors always ? 4, overflow correct
[ ] ec=true header ? encrypted response still works
[ ] data_places is [] not null when no results

Files Changed

src/Models/PlacesModel.go                   ? add DistanceKm *float64
src/Action/V1/Places/PlacesHandlers.go      ? nearest mode logic (imports + 4 sections)

No route changes. No DB view changes. No migration required.
